summary: RBAC-04 Picker and Notification Privacy: implemented getProjectPeople, getEligibleAssignees, getEligibleMentionees, getHistoricalPersonDisplay, and GET /api/v1/projects/:projectId/people. Exposes only active project members and workspace owner. Assignees include owner/manager/member (excluding viewers); mentionees include owner/manager/member/viewer. Removed members flagged historical and unassignable/unmentionable; sibling project members strictly excluded. Audited and certified by independent reviewer with score 9.7/10.0.
